notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Added a prompt on starting a new game giving players the option to turn music on[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We've turned music off by default due to a content ID error that's causing copyright strikes on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. [/p][p][/p][p]That way, anyone who wants to play with music can easily turn it on while players streaming or capturing for Twitch/YouTube won't have their videos muted or demonetised. [/p][p][/p][p]When this issue is resolved, we'll turn music back on by default. YouTube is already fixed, so we're well on our way! Twitch is next. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've had a video muted or demonetised, please send a message with a link to the affected video(s) to [url="https://support@surgentstudios.com"]support@surgentstudios.com[/url].   [/p][p][/p][h3]Dead Take Official Streaming Permission [/h3][p]You have full permission to stream, record, and monetise videos of Dead Take, including all in-game music. [/p][p]We are the creators and rights holders of the soundtrack. If you receive a copyright claim or muted content notice (e.g. on YouTube or Twitch), it is likely due to automatic detection through music fingerprinting services. [/p][p]We are in the process of removing the soundtrack from all such systems so this will not happen in the future.  [/p][p]In the meantime, you may dispute the claim citing the following: “I have permission from the rights holder to use this music.” [/p][p]You can also include the URL for this post as part of your verification. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support! We are so appreciative of your streams and videos.  [/p][p][/p][p]-The Surgent Team[/p]

notes.title: Dead Take (PC) Review
notes.content:
When it comes to crafting a good horror story, atmosphere is essential. While visuals and creepy storytelling help set the tone, good audio design can do much of the heavy lifting—if you know what you’re doing. The team at Surgent Studios clearly had this in mind when developing Dead Take, their latest horror puzzle game. To that end, they enlisted the help of some notable voice actors, including Neil Newbon, Ben Starr, Laura Bailey, Sam Lake and many more.

That’s not to say Dead Take slouches in other areas. While the game’s sound design is immaculate—featuring eerie ambient noises and top-tier voice acting—it also looks fantastic. Players will spend most of their time wandering through an abandoned yet opulent mansion after a disastrous party. The elegant halls never fail to inspire unease—whether you’re exploring confetti-strewn corridors, dismantling an overworked robot vacuum for puzzle components, or discovering that a bloodstained baby crib has been moved into the room you... notes.title: Dead Take to Star Two Fan-Favourite Video Game Actors
notes.content:
Surgent Studios’ upcoming psychological horror game is set to feature two renowned video game actors in its leading roles.

Announced via press release, Surgent Studios, known for Tales of Kenzera: ZAU and Palworld publisher Pocketpair, confirmed that Ben Starr and Neil Newbon will be portraying the main characters in Dead Take. Fans will be familiar with Starr from his incredible performances as Clive in Final Fantasy XVI and Verso Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Newbon is most well-known for his portrayal of Elijah Kamski and Gavin Reed from Detroit: Become Human and Astarion in Baldur’s Gate 3.

Surgent Studios has also unveiled a new teaser for Dead Take, which can be seen below.

notes.title: NEW TEASER REVEALED FOR DEAD TAKE
notes.content:
Hello to our new community here on Steam!

Yesterday, we revealed the title and cover art for our next game,[b] Dead Take [/b]: a psychological horror about power and corruption in the entertainment industry.

It's our second game as a studio, and our first with Pocketpair Publishing!

[b]We also revealed a new teaser to give you a taste of what to expect. Check it out:[/b]

[previewyoutube=2VKPIPgenk8;full][/previewyoutube]

This marks the first time we've shown any visuals from the game. 

Since the reveal, we've already updated our Steam store page with the new teaser, new screenshots, and a few new GIFs as well.

[h1]PEELING BACK THE FACADE [/h1]
We're playing it close to the chest with this reveal, but rest assured there's a lot more to come. From gameplay to cast reveal, you'll want to keep a weather eye on the horizon.

[h1]COMING FOR YOU[/h1]
Add Dead Take to your wishlist and be the first to know when we're live.

We [i]can [/i]tell you that it's coming this year. And sooner than you might think.

[b]You certainly have more questions than answers. Feel free to ask them here! We're curious to know what you're curious about.[/b]

- Surgent team
